recommendations.headline: Call satisfaction is the single biggest driver of sales: win rate is 71% when customers are satisfied vs only 15% when neutral and 5% when dissatisfied, yet 52% of calls (1,365) end neutral and price is never even discussed in 71% of calls (1,870) — the gap is in how reps run the call, not in price.
behaviour: 457 customers are price shoppers and 278 are actively comparing quotes, together over 27% of all calls, showing most buyers shop around before committing.
483 customers need fast delivery and 481 need stock confirmation, the two most common needs, ahead of technical advice (433) and regular updates (213).
238 are repeat buyers and 234 are bulk buyers, showing a strong existing base worth retaining, but only 21 are tagged loyal_to_us.
385 customers need technical help (sizing, thickness, bends) indicating many calls require consultative selling, not just quoting.
168 customers are indecisive and 103 need credit, both segments that convert only with active follow-through from reps.
satisfaction: Only 36% of calls (944) end satisfied, 52% (1,365) are neutral and 8.5% (225) dissatisfied; satisfaction level almost perfectly predicts order outcome (71%/15%/5% win rates).

Price is rarely the blocker in outright terms: price_blocker_pct is only 16% and price_reaction shows 'too_high' in just 82 calls vs 290 accepted and 407 negotiating — most price conversations are negotiable, not rejected.

70.6% of calls (1,870) never get to a price discussion at all, meaning reps are losing deals before price even becomes an issue — likely due to slow/unclear answers (433 cases) or no quote sent (249 cases).

Price_high is still the top objection (355 calls) but wins there (27%) are close to the average for stock_availability (25%) and delivery_time (26%), showing price is one of several equally important blockers, not the dominant one.

conversion.title: Fix the 'neutral call' problem first
conversion.evidence: 52% of calls (1,365) end neutral with only 15% win rate, vs 71% win rate when satisfied — the single largest lever in the data.
conversion.action: Coach reps on call close checklist: confirm requirement, give a clear answer/quote, state next step and follow-up date before ending every call.

conversion.title: Always send a quote
conversion.evidence: No_quote_sent flagged in 249 calls and 70.6% of calls never reach a price discussion.
conversion.action: Make sending a written quote (WhatsApp/email) mandatory within the same call or within 1 hour, even for small enquiries.

conversion.title: Ask for the order explicitly
conversion.evidence: didnt_ask_for_order flagged in 244 calls; order outcome is only 19% of all calls despite 386 marked 'interested'.
conversion.action: Train reps to always close with a direct ask: 'Shall I confirm this order?' once requirement and price are agreed.

conversion.title: Fix slow/unclear answers
conversion.evidence: slow_or_unclear_answer is the top rep gap at 433 calls, and 433 customers separately flagged needing technical_advice.
conversion.action: Build a quick-reference sheet of specs, thickness options and standard sizes so reps answer technical questions in real time without 'let me check and call back.'

conversion.title: Set and keep follow-up dates
conversion.evidence: no_follow_up_fixed in 414 calls; callback is the largest outcome bucket at 46% (1,229 calls).
conversion.action: Every callback outcome must get a specific date/time logged and a reminder; manager to audit weekly follow-up completion.

conversion.title: Prioritise stock and delivery clarity
conversion.evidence: stock_availability (353 calls, 25% win) and delivery_time (216 calls, 26% win) are objections almost as damaging as price_high (355 calls, 27% win).
conversion.action: Give reps real-time stock visibility and standard delivery-time commitments to quote confidently instead of 'will check and call back.'

conversion.title: Offer alternatives when exact match unavailable
conversion.evidence: didnt_offer_alternative flagged in 148 calls; several summaries show lost deals on unavailable thickness/brand (e.g. 0.7mm JSW sheet, UPVC sheet, liner sheet).
conversion.action: Train reps to always propose an in-stock substitute (e.g. Color On Plus for unavailable colors) before ending the call.

offers.title: Fast-track quote service
offers.for_whom: Price shoppers and comparing-quotes customers (457+278 calls)
offers.why: 70.6% of calls never reach a price discussion; faster quotes convert comparison shoppers before they finalize elsewhere.

offers.title: Technical consultation line/visit
offers.for_whom: Customers needing technical advice (433 calls) e.g. puff vs normal sheet, thickness selection
offers.why: Technical-help need is the 3rd largest behaviour/need category and strongly tied to satisfied, high-win calls.

offers.title: Cutting and custom-size processing
offers.why: Cutting_processing need flagged in 109 calls; several won calls involved cutting/bend requests handled well.

offers.title: Consider a structured credit-period option
offers.for_whom: needs_credit segment (103 calls) and credit_terms objection (80 calls, 29% win)
offers.why: Credit_terms has one of the higher win rates among objections, suggesting flexible terms convert well when offered.

offers.title: Site/direct delivery scheduling slots
offers.for_whom: Customers needing site_delivery (112 calls) and fast_delivery (483 calls, the single largest need)
offers.why: Fast_delivery is the top customer need overall; committing to clear time slots addresses the delivery_time objection (216 calls).

offers.title: Sample/test-certificate service
offers.why: Samples requested in 69 calls, test_certificate in 21 calls, and quality_doubt is an objection in 98 calls (27% win).

loyalty.title: Consider a formal repeat-buyer recognition program
loyalty.how: Tag and periodically acknowledge the 238 repeat_buyer and 21 loyal_to_us customers with priority handling or small gestures (gifts were already an expectation per multiple summaries about Diwali gifts).
loyalty.why: Repeat/loyal buyers already show strong behaviour signals; formalizing recognition can protect this base from competitor approaches (96 competitor_cheaper mentions).

loyalty.title: Priority callback SLA for satisfied/repeat customers
loyalty.how: Flag repeat and bulk buyers for guaranteed callback within a fixed window instead of general queue.
loyalty.why: Satisfied calls win 71% of the time; protecting this segment's experience sustains the biggest win-rate driver.

loyalty.title: Consider reinstating/clarifying promotional gifts
loyalty.how: Confirm and communicate a clear annual gifting policy (e.g. Diwali) to avoid disappointment.
loyalty.why: Multiple summaries show dealers asking about missing Diwali gifts/promotional items, indicating this was a valued past practice.

loyalty.title: Dedicated account contact for top dealers
loyalty.how: Assign a named rep/account owner to top-volume dealers (dealer segment is 1,262 calls, 40% win, the highest-performing segment) so they always know 'who is handling my account' (asked directly in calls).
loyalty.why: Dealer segment has best win rate; consistent contact reduces churn risk to competitors like JSW, Tata, Asian.

loyalty.title: Consider a referral recognition scheme
loyalty.how: Track and reward customers who refer others (30 referral-tagged calls already present).
loyalty.why: Referral behaviour exists organically; recognizing it can grow volume at low cost.

non_price_benefits.title: Fast, reliable delivery commitments
non_price_benefits.why: Fast_delivery is the top need (483 calls) and delivery_time the 3rd largest objection (216 calls).

non_price_benefits.title: Wide colour/brand range and in-stock alternatives
non_price_benefits.why: Color On Plus is the 2nd most discussed product (288 mentions) and reps successfully offered alternatives in won calls (e.g. Radiance unavailable, Color On Plus substituted).

non_price_benefits.title: Technical expertise on specs, thickness and bends
non_price_benefits.why: 433 calls flagged technical_advice need; several won calls closed after good technical guidance (e.g. puff sheet vs normal sheet).

non_price_benefits.title: Quality assurance and test certification
non_price_benefits.why: Quality_doubt objection present in 98 calls and test_certificate need in 21 calls; offering documentation builds trust.

non_price_benefits.title: Consistent stock availability
non_price_benefits.why: Stock_availability is the 2nd largest objection (353 calls) and 2nd largest need (481 calls).

non_price_benefits.title: Proactive regular order updates
non_price_benefits.why: 213 calls show a need for regular_updates, directly addressable by better follow-up discipline (currently missing in 414 calls).

top_questions.question: Is this thickness/size/color available in stock?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm real-time stock status before the call ends; if unavailable, immediately offer the closest in-stock alternative (e.g. Color On Plus).

top_questions.question: What is the rate for this sheet/screw/coil?
top_questions.answer_tip: Always follow up verbally with a written quote on WhatsApp/email in the same interaction, avoid 'will check and call back.'

top_questions.question: Can delivery happen today/tomorrow morning/by a specific day?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a specific, realistic delivery commitment and confirm it in writing rather than a vague timeframe.

top_questions.question: Why is your rate higher than competitor X?
top_questions.answer_tip: Reframe around quality assurance, consistent stock, technical support and reliable delivery rather than discounting.

top_questions.question: Can you send photos/diagrams/specs on WhatsApp?
top_questions.answer_tip: Make this a standard step in every enquiry call, don't wait to be asked twice.

top_questions.question: Can I get credit terms / pay balance later?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain current payment process clearly and escalate credit_term requests to management for case-by-case evaluation rather than declining outright.

top_questions.question: Has my previous quotation/order/payment been processed?
top_questions.answer_tip: Always check and confirm order/payment status proactively at the start of the call; set a fixed follow-up date if unresolved.

top_questions.question: Can you do cutting/custom sizing for my project?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm cutting and custom-size capability upfront and set clear expectations on turnaround time.
